description: footRoll 20 and bank 10: the toe pivot turns the ankle first (it is last in the chain), +20, to (4, 4.573421, 0.347967). Then the bank turns that -10 about forward at bankOut (4.4, 3.2, 1.6), offset (dx -0.4, dy 1.373421): x = 4.4 - 0.4 cos10 + 1.373421 sin10 = 4.244569, y = 3.2 + 0.4 sin10 + 1.373421 cos10 = 4.622015. The toe pivot is the toe joint (4, 3.3, 1.8), so the hand at (4, 4, 0) is offset (dy 0.7, dz -1.8) from it, the toe bone's length 1.931321, and it keeps that length to the planted toe. The Limb is at IK, so its hand reaches the foot's ankle target.
